text: This is a free and secure service provided by the New York State Comptroller’s Office of Unclaimed Funds to claim lost money.
Enter your last name or the name of your business in the Last or Business Name field and select Search .
Your search returned 1000 unclaimed properties. Exact name matches will be shown first, followed by properties with similar names to the one entered.
